lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a pair of special meetings on Tuesday, September 30th that put the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific Avenue front and center — HARC takes up the preliminary architecture review for the project's multiple building clusters while Town Council holds an appeal hearing on the underlying lot subdivision that makes any of it possible. The Gondola Leadership Committee meets Sunday to weigh federal funding versus local financing for the gondola project, and the County commissioners dig into a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee on Tuesday. On the lighter side, Original Thinkers kicks off Thursday and First Friday brings live music and gallery openings to close out the week.
